replies.body: What is your opinion on this particular issue? Something can be done, and will be done as soon as possible however I like to involve the reporter in situations like this.

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
I'm not completely sure what you mean, but the people are in a way "bullying" Shadow. I mean, here is a comment posted by Pedroh: 
"I'm not even from the avicus community, I'm just making people aware of how much of a dick you are."

In my opinion, even if all this is true they don't have the right to be saying all that in such a rude way. Also, thanks a lot for asking what I thought. I feel if you do this, it'll get reporters more involved with working with the staff. :)

replies.author: Yuuji
replies.body:
Ok thanks for that, since they have not recieved a warning of some sorts, I will step in and archive all unnecessary comments and verbally tell the perpetrators to stop being rude towards an individual. 
Thank you for alerting us!

It is in my best interest to maintain and encourage community-staff interaction with player reports.. incase you're wondering why I decided to ask you for your opinion. 
Have a great day, and keep up the good work!
